clue.text: Fodder racks for cattle and horses

definitions.meaning: a hack is a wooden rack from which cattle eat hay
a hack is a horse hired out or kept for ordinary riding

explanation.surface: A farmer describes the feed racks put out for livestock and horses.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses of one word: a feeding rack in a byre, and an everyday riding horse.

clue.text: Just the cocktail for a society dance

definitions.meaning: a spirit and mixer served in a tall glass
a ..., read literally, is a grand ball for high society

explanation.surface: This drink is exactly right for a smart social occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall mixed drink, and read as two words a dance for the upper classes.

clue.text: City that had style in the past

parts.note: chic means stylishness
ago means earlier, in the past

explanation.surface: A town that was once fashionable but no longer is.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest urban centre in Illinois, USA.

clue.text: Small, ugly old woman wants rough-cut tobacco

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for small, as on clothing labels
a hag is an ugly old woman or witch

explanation.surface: A little crone is after some coarse pipe tobacco.
explanation.definitionFit: A coarsely shredded pipe tobacco.

clue.text: Criminal concerning fire guard

parts.note: of can mean about or concerning, as in 'tales of the sea'
a fender is the low metal guard around a fireplace

explanation.surface: A lawbreaker's link to a fireplace guard is under discussion.
explanation.definitionFit: A lawbreaker is one who commits an offence.

clue.text: Deaf man resolved with luck to gain the fruits of success

indicators.note: resolved, in the sense of worked out anew, tells us these letters are rearranged

parts.note: fortune means luck

explanation.surface: A deaf man overcomes his difficulties and with good luck achieves success.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resolved' turns DEAF MAN into FAME AND; 'with' and 'to gain' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: Renown and wealth are the classic rewards of achievement.

clue.text: Aims to reach conclusions

definitions.meaning: ... are goals or purposes, as in '... and means'
finishes or final parts

explanation.surface: Goals are set so as to arrive at a result.
explanation.definitionFit: The word covers both purposes and finishing points.

clue.text: Calls for a return to the paths of righteousness

definitions.meaning: to drop in is to call on someone, to visit casually

definitions.text: a return to the paths of righteousness
definitions.meaning: read as drops sin, giving up wrongdoing

explanation.surface: A preacher urges the congregation to come back to virtuous living.
explanation.walkthrough: Split differently the answer reads 'drops sin', which is what a reformed sinner does.
explanation.definitionFit: Paying a casual visit, and humorously one who abandons wickedness.

clue.text: Annoyed at being infested with vermin

definitions.meaning: informal for irritable or cross
literally, full of rats

explanation.surface: Someone is cross because their house is full of pests.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal for irritable, and literally overrun with rodents.

clue.text: Songs one emigre composed for his novels

indicators.note: composed, in the sense of put together, tells us these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An exile writes songs to go with his novels.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is loose: the man known for his novels, the Belgian creator of Inspector Maigret, who did emigrate to France.
explanation.definitionFit: This Belgian-born author wrote scores of Maigret detective novels.

clue.text: I am in favour, despite the wry expression

indicators.note: in tells us the first piece sits inside the word for favour

parts.note: grace means favour, as in being in someone's good graces
I am contracts to I'm, giving IM

explanation.surface: Someone backs a plan but pulls a face about it all the same.
explanation.walkthrough: 'despite' is only a link word joining the wordplay to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A twisted facial look of disgust or pain is a wry face.

clue.text: Pretended to be distinguished

definitions.meaning: to make out is to claim falsely
to make out is to discern or pick out something faintly seen

explanation.surface: Someone only acted as if they had achieved eminence.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb covers both claiming falsely and managing to discern something.

clue.text: Bill is a master at Eton

definitions.meaning: a bird's bill is also called its ...
old school slang for a schoolmaster (or a magistrate)

explanation.surface: A man called Bill teaches at Eton, the famous English boarding school.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird's hard mouthpart, and public-school slang for a teacher.

clue.text: A minor route, but of ample size

definitions.meaning: a ... is a secondary road in Britain, below the main A-roads
wide or spacious

explanation.surface: A small back road that turns out to be surprisingly wide.
explanation.walkthrough: British roads are classed as A (major) and B (minor) roads.
explanation.definitionFit: A secondary British highway, and an adjective meaning wide.

clue.text: Observe an English agent

parts.note: a secret agent is a spy

explanation.surface: Someone is told to keep watch on a British secret agent.
explanation.definitionFit: To catch sight of or spot something.

clue.text: A large number of jalopies

definitions.meaning: lots, informally
a heap is slang for a decrepit old car

explanation.surface: A scrapyard holds a whole lot of battered old cars.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal for lots, and slang for broken-down motor cars.

clue.text: Young supporter of the ecology party

definitions.meaning: inexperienced or immature
a member of an environmentalist political party is a ...

explanation.surface: A young person backs the environmentalist political party.
explanation.definitionFit: Inexperienced and naive, and a member of an environmental party.

clue.text: General interpretation of what peeling plaster means?

definitions.meaning: a free, inexact translation or reading
rendering is a coat of plaster on a wall, so flaking plaster is rendering coming loose

explanation.surface: A broad explanation of what flaking wall plaster signifies.
explanation.definitionFit: A free translation, and plaster coating that has come away from the wall.

clue.text: A little speculation made in an agitated state

parts.note: a flutter is a small bet or gamble

explanation.surface: A small gamble on the market leaves someone nervous.
explanation.definitionFit: Nervously excited, fluttery.

clue.text: Settle down to write music unassisted!

definitions.meaning: to calm yourself after being upset
taken literally, to compose music on your own

explanation.surface: Someone is urged to calm down and write a tune alone.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means regain calm; read literally it is creating music by yourself.

clue.text: Silver in extravagant setting is an abomination

indicators.note: in puts the silver symbol inside the word for extravagant

parts.note: outre means unconventional or extravagant
Ag is the chemical symbol for silver

explanation.surface: Silver in an over-the-top mounting is a disgrace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setting' sits with 'in' to describe the jewel mount picture; it adds no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Something shocking and wicked, an atrocity.

clue.text: Component found in the periodic table

definitions.meaning: a basic part of something
the chemical substances listed in the periodic table

explanation.surface: A constituent part appears on the chemists' chart.
explanation.definitionFit: A constituent part, and a basic chemical substance such as carbon.

clue.text: Some of those leaving a terminal for exit to plane

indicators.note: some of says only a portion of the words that follow is used

explanation.surface: A few departing passengers head out of the airport building towards their aircraft.
explanation.definitionFit: At an airport, passengers board their aircraft through a numbered departure door.

clue.text: Turn and take one's leave

definitions.meaning: milk that turns sour is said to go bad
to depart

explanation.surface: Someone spins round and departs.
explanation.definitionFit: Of food, to become sour or rotten; of a person, to depart.

clue.text: Smears former South African PM

definitions.meaning: specks of soot or dirty marks
Prime Minister of South Africa

explanation.surface: A former South African leader is the target of a smear campaign.
explanation.definitionFit: Sooty marks, and the surname of the statesman Jan Christiaan.

clue.text: Live with a socially-acceptable boyfriend

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
U means upper-class or socially acceptable, from the old U and non-U distinction

explanation.surface: Someone moves in with a respectable partner.
explanation.definitionFit: An old-fashioned word for a male admirer or sweetheart.

clue.text: Food served by a gorgeous girl or guy

definitions.meaning: a prepared item of food
slang for an attractive person

explanation.surface: A meal is brought out by a very attractive waiter.
explanation.definitionFit: A course of food, and slang for a good-looking person.

clue.text: Friends who hit back

indicators.note: back tells us the word for hit is read in reverse

parts.note: to slap is to hit

explanation.surface: Mates who retaliate when struck.
explanation.definitionFit: Informal word for mates or chums.

clue.text: Change of Ontario address

indicators.note: change of tells us the letters of the next word are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Canadian province gets a new postal address.
explanation.definitionFit: Address as a noun means a formal speech.

clue.text: To dine in the snuggery is most elegant

indicators.note: in places the eating word inside the cosy-room word

parts.note: a snuggery, a cosy little room, is a nest
to dine is to eat

explanation.surface: Eating in the cosy back room of a pub is the classiest option.
explanation.definitionFit: The superlative of tidy or trim, meaning smartest.

clue.text: Voluntary worker given total independence

parts.note: free means given willingly, unpaid
a hand is a manual worker, as in a farmhand

explanation.surface: An unpaid volunteer is allowed to do as they please.
explanation.definitionFit: To be given this phrase is to have complete freedom to act.

clue.text: Instrument is returned to Jack

indicators.note: returned means the little word is turned back to front

parts.note: a jack tar, or tar, is a sailor

explanation.surface: An object is handed back to a man named Jack.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-necked Indian lute played with plucked strings.
